rows.TEXT: Highest lord of the dwarf lords, he is known for his intensity in battle and his courage in the face of overwhelming odds. He once fought seven days and nights against the mighty red dragon ARFURUZON to finally defeat him.

Every child trembles at the hearing of this most infamous name. This lord of hell is known for his blood thirsts. It is said that he once ate 1000 slaves at a banquet given by Bethrezen for a victory against the kingdom of light.

Known in his times as the mightiest of all adepts of the black art, this lord was slain by the inquisitor Vorgel who ended his reign of terror. He is now resurrected as an undead with the intention to subjugate every mortal to his will.
A veteran in the struggle to reclaim Elven glory, nobody enters the forest without her knowledge.

Orcs 
"We chase out humans, soon we come back to chase you out."

Mage 
"Leave this place while you still live!"

Hill Giant 
"Long ago, the Humans ruled this region. Under their reign the Giant Spiders were defeated time and again. With their absence I fear that this region will once again be home to the Giant Spiders. Proceed with haste."

Tempest Giant 
"The Orcs have murdered many Humans and Barbarians. Proceed with caution do not let them weaken our front line. Neither the Orcs, Humans nor Barbarians will defeat us."

Ashkael 
"Human bones are scattered across the land. The Orcs are mighty if you come across them defeat them quick before their numbers overwhelm you. We will not suffer the fate of the humans!"

Duke  
"I believe that we are in the middle of an ongoing conflict between the Orcs and the Humans. Destroy anyone who gets in your way."

Ghost 
"Master I sense that there are many Goblins and Orcs. They watch us now as I speak to you."

Ghost 
"I sense that we have disturbed an Orc rites of passage! The Orcs and Goblins will attack us, we must be prepared at all times."

Orc 
"Orc you must go or Orc will get mad!"

Hermit 
"The Orcs have built numerous prisons throughout this war torn region. Destroy the prisons and we may find what we are looking for!"

Wizard 
"Orcs are strong but the spiders will be here soon, they are dangerous."

Mage 
"The spiders will come and destroy you. Many humans have died defeding this land from them! You will have the same fate."

Orc 
"No one will defeat our Champion."

Orc 
"Orcs rule this land get out!"

Orc 
"We will crush your kind. Orcs fear nothing. You and the humans shall share the same fate. Death by our hands!"

Orc 
"Orcs destroy strangers! Orcs burn cities where strangers live!"
My savage Barbarians  will fight for your cause ... for the right price.

Squire 
"Orcs are everywhere! Concentrate on them while you can the spiders will be here soon enough. Rest in this city while you can because we will take it back!"
My spells are the most potent in the region.

Arch-Angel 
"In the name of the Highfather we will claim this land! You have been warned!"
My items are the best in the realm.
The Barbarian Shamoness has returned seeking revenge! She is not alone either. Only with her defeat will you be able to claim the land. Find and destroy the Shamoness.

Centaur 
"I have heard that the humans will try to recapture the territory. Stay away from the Humans and the Orcs they will try to butcher us in their war."

Scout 
"We have entered in the middle of an ongoing conflict. Our enemies are everywhere proceed with caution. I have heard that the prisons hold a number of useful items. We will conquer this land in the name of Gallean!"

Elf Ranger 
"I have learned that the Dragon named Bastion knows where the Ocean Charm is! By defeating this powerful creature we will find the Oceam Charm and defeat our enemies."

Abyssal Devil 
"Through the souls of the departed I have learned where the Ocean Charm may be found. Defeat the Dragon known as Bastien and you shall find the charm! Now leave!"

Archlich 
"The Dragon, search for the Blue Dragon and you shall find the Ocean Charm. Only with the Dragon's death shall we find the Charm and rule this land."

Forge Guardian 
"I know where we may find the Ocean Charm. Find the Blue Dragon and defeat the foul beast and the charm shall be ours!"

Orc King 
"We will be avenged! An Orc Champion will appear. In time all shall fall to the wrath of our Champion!"

Orc Champion 
"Kill! Death and pain shall come! Death to those who have defeated my King!"

Marksman 
"You fools! Your constant battles have provoked the dragon! The destructive beast will destroy anyone that gets in its way. Even if you find the water wards you would be wise to stay out of the beast's way!"
